message.content:
This document is the README for **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack. Key technical points:

**Purpose & features**
- Runs large open models locally with an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API (tool calls, coding agents).
- Handles up to 8 concurrent requests via GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.
- Includes browser chat + live monitor, image support, thinking levels, a Models page (download/load/delete), a Turbo button, and one-command setup (`./setup.sh` or
